title: High School DxD Specials
justification: AniList 13357 has 6 episodes (2012-03-21 to 2012-08-29); English title 'High School DxD: Fantasy Jiggles Unleashed'. AniDB 8660 S1-S6 are the 'Mousou Bakuyure Kaijo Original Video Vol.1-6' (Going Sunbathing, Akeno's Personal Training, Koneko..., Dress Break..., We Are Making Udon, Asia Transforms) on 2012-03-21, 04-25, 05-23, 06-27, 07-25, 08-29. The parent's row shifts them by one, so they land on TVDB 254653 0x02-0x07, which are 'Fantasy Jiggles Unleashed - Vol. 1..6' on exactly those six dates, and TMDB tv/45950 S0E2-7 likewise. S7 'Before Harem Special' is 0x01 and S8, S9 are other items.
